title: Real Research Today: Hypersonic Airliners 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Hypersonic Airliners 2.0.
description:
The road to Hypersonic Airliners 2.0 is already being paved. Hydrogen aviation programs (Airbus ZEROe, Universal Hydrogen) fly fuel-cell regional aircraft. The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies.

The eVTOL industry (Joby, Archer, Lilium) certifies electric air taxis with aviation authorities. Together these programs form the scramjet cores foundation that Hypersonic Airliners 2.0 will build on — the airliner logistics results, the thermal protection methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as airliner logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Hypersonic Airliners 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hypersonic Airliners 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hypersonic Airliners 2.0 — next-gen Mach-5+ passenger aircraft.

Phase 1 — Prove (scramjet cores): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (airliner logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (thermal protection): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (boom management): airliner hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aviation-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
